About Me

My name is Cao Minh Nguyet, born in 2000 and currently living in Hanoi, Vietnam.

I spent four years studying at Keimyung University in South Korea. Living and studying abroad provided me with valuable international experience, strengthened my independence, and enhanced my adaptability as well as my cross-cultural communication skills.

After returning to Vietnam, I began my professional journey and gained experience in several different roles, including Korean–Vietnamese Interpreter, Executive Assistant, Creator Scouter, and Data Annotator.

Testing

Manual Testing and API Testing

As an entry-level QA Tester, I have hands-on experience creating and maintaining testing documentation, including Test Plans, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, Test Data, Test Execution Reports, Defect Reports, Test Summary Reports, and Test Checklists. I can analyze requirements, identify test scenarios, design test cases with clear test steps and expected results, execute functional and regression testing, record actual results and evidence, and document defects with relevant details.

I have hands-on experience performing API testing using Postman. I can work with common HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, configure request parameters, headers, authorization, and request bodies, and verify response status codes, response bodies, headers, and returned data against expected results. I can also organize API test cases and document test results, defects, and testing conclusions.
